successCriteria.description: The `LeaveNotification` entity interface is exported from `src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts` with exactly 9 fields: `id` (string), `recipientId` (string), `type` (string literal union of 'SUBMITTED' | 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED' | 'CANCELLED' | 'BALANCE_LOW' | 'BALANCE_EXHAUSTED'), `title` (string), `message` (string), `leaveRequestId` (string), `status` (NotificationStatus enum imported from `src/shared/types`), `createdAt` (Date), `readAt` (Date | null).

The `INotificationRepository` interface is exported from `src/modules/notification/notification.repository.ts` with exactly 5 methods: `findById(id: string): Promise<LeaveNotification | null>`, `findByRecipientId(recipientId: string): Promise<LeaveNotification[]>`, `findByLeaveRequestId(leaveRequestId: string): Promise<LeaveNotification[]>`, `create(notification: Omit<LeaveNotification, 'id' | 'createdAt'>): Promise<LeaveNotification>`, `updateStatus(id: string, status: NotificationStatus): Promise<LeaveNotification | null>`.
A stub `NotificationRepository` class is exported that implements `INotificationRepository`; every method throws `new Error('not implemented')` when called.
A barrel export `src/modules/notification/index.ts` re-exports the `LeaveNotification` interface, the `INotificationRepository` interface, and the `NotificationRepository` stub class.

Unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.model.test.ts` verify: all 9 fields exist with correct types, the `type` field accepts all 6 string literal values, the `status` field accepts all 4 NotificationStatus enum values, `readAt` accepts both Date and null, and the interface has exactly the expected field count.

Unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.repository.test.ts` verify: the stub can be instantiated, all 5 methods exist as functions, and each method rejects with `'not implemented'` when called.

constraints: No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).

No direct database access outside the repository layer — the stub `NotificationRepository` is the only place database calls will eventually live (GP-001, HARNESS constraint `no-direct-db-outside-repository`).
No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or tokens (HARNESS constraint `no-hardcoded-secrets`).
No `@gestalt/*` packages as project dependencies (HARNESS constraint `no-gestalt-internal-deps`).
Strict TypeScript: `strict: true`, `noImplicitAny: true`, `strictNullChecks: true` — the code must compile under `tsc --noEmit` with no errors.
outOfScope: NotificationService (interface and implementation) — deferred to Phase 10 per PLAN.md.
Database-backed repository implementation (Knex/PostgreSQL queries) — this phase delivers only the stub.
HTTP routes, controllers, or any Fastify plugin registration for notifications.
Audit logging integration — the notification module does not produce audit records in this phase (audit is Phase 7).

entityInvariants.invariant: Lifecycle: PENDING → SENT → READ → ARCHIVED. The `status` field must always hold a valid `NotificationStatus` enum value. The `readAt` field must be `null` when status is PENDING or SENT; it must be a non-null `Date` when status is READ or ARCHIVED. The `type` field must be one of the 6 string literals: 'SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED', 'BALANCE_LOW', 'BALANCE_EXHAUSTED'. The `leaveRequestId` is a string reference to a LeaveRequest.id — referential integrity is enforced at the service/DB layer in later phases.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository layer — auth is enforced at the service/controller layer in later phases.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns `null` when no notification exists with the given id; never throws for a missing entity.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Accepts `Omit<LeaveNotification, 'id' | 'createdAt'>` — the caller must NOT supply `id` or `createdAt`; the repository assigns them. Returns the created `LeaveNotification` with all fields populated.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Only mutates the `status` field (and implicitly `readAt` when transitioning to READ). Returns the updated `LeaveNotification` or `null` if no notification exists with the given id.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `NotificationStatus` enum must be imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — do NOT redefine or duplicate it in the notification module.

The `LeaveNotification` entity's `leaveRequestId` field is a string reference to `LeaveRequest.id`. The notification module must NOT import from `src/modules/leave-request/` — the dependency map in reconciled.json shows `notification → shared-types` only.

The model file must follow the established pattern: export the interface with a JSDoc comment describing the entity and its invariants, import shared types from `../../shared/types` (relative path matching sibling modules like employee, leave-policy, leave-request).

The repository file must follow the established pattern: export both the interface (prefixed with `I`) and a stub class, with each stub method accepting prefixed-underscore parameters and throwing `new Error('not implemented')`. The interface JSDoc must reference GP-001.

The barrel export `index.ts` must re-export the model interface and both the repository interface and stub class, matching the pattern used by employee, leave-policy, leave-balance, and leave-request modules.

integrationPoints.why: Imports `NotificationStatus` enum (PENDING, SENT, READ, ARCHIVED) for the `status` field on `LeaveNotification`.
